title: A/R Detail lines keep their information and the invoice's location
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • You are signed in to ShopView as an Admin user.
  • Customer X has an open invoice made at location B.
custom_steps:
1. Open the Reports menu.
  2. Click "A/R Aging Detail" in the left list.
  3. Open every bucket.
  4. Find customer X's invoice.
  5. Read the whole line.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 5:

  • date, transaction type "Invoice", the invoice ID, customer X's full name, location B, the due date, Amount and Open balance. (Heading capitals and the column name "Location" are new by design.)

Why this matters: Each line must still say what, whose, where and how much.
